review_mode: Scheduled cloud dual-review; independent Codex desk
limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.
Only material new or materially changed evidence belonging to the current Friday session is listed. Items from a prior completed session are not caught up after that session has closed.

The latest Mettis E&P profit headline could not be opened in the cloud reader. It is labelled headline-only and was not promoted to a new rating because a substantially similar FY26 sector earnings and super-tax story was already published on September 16.

The latest Mettis cotton-arrivals link could not be opened and the accessible syndication exposed only the publication date, not an exact clock time. It is labelled headline-only and is not used in a score-bearing rating.

Aggregate mobile-phone import data is not treated as company-specific evidence for AIRLINK; the observed mix is directionally ambiguous for a company involved in both import distribution and local device activity.

reviewed_stories.title: Iran says struck oil tanker in Strait of Hormuz
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link to OGDC, PPL and MARI through the oil supply-risk premium; no company-specific operating event
reviewed_stories.reason: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they struck and detained the Togo-flagged tanker Trend after an attempted passage through Hormuz, while UKMTO separately reported a projectile strike and fire. This confirms continuing physical shipping risk. Reuters simultaneously reported Brent near $102.68, down about 2%, because Saudi supply workarounds and inventories were easing immediate scarcity fears, so the new attack reinforces but does not upgrade the existing low-confidence positive upstream view.

reviewed_stories.title: Mobile phone imports decline 8.85% in July-August: PBS
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link to Technology and Communication, including AIRLINK; no company-specific sales or margin evidence
reviewed_stories.reason: Mobile-phone imports fell 8.85% year on year in July-August while telecom-equipment imports rose 8.95%. PSX confirms AIRLINK imports and distributes communication products, but the aggregate import mix does not show whether lower handset imports reflect weaker end demand, greater local assembly, or a mix shift. No directional AIRLINK earnings conclusion is justified.

reviewed_stories.title: Pakistan Oil & Gas sector profits surge 25% to Rs461bn in FY26
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link to listed exploration and production companies, but not a new company event
reviewed_stories.reason: The fresh Mettis headline says FY26 sector profit rose 25% to Rs461bn, but the linked article body was not accessible. A Business Recorder report on September 16 had already disclosed the same broad FY26 E&P earnings and super-tax-reversal story, with Rs459.8bn of sector earnings under Topline's methodology. This is therefore treated as a headline-only restatement, not a new basis to raise OGDC, PPL or MARI ratings.

reviewed_stories.title: Pakistan cotton arrivals surge 19% to 2.4m bales by Sept 15
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link to tracked textile names through domestic cotton availability; no company-specific evidence
reviewed_stories.reason: The accessible syndication says cotton arrivals reached 2,388,682 bales by September 15, up 19.17% year on year. That is constructive for domestic raw-cotton availability, but the original Mettis article could not be opened and no exact source clock time was exposed, so this remains headline-only evidence and is not used for a score-bearing textile rating.

reviewed_stories.title: Pakistan will go to any length to defend Saudi Arabia: DG ISPR
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Broad geopolitical and sovereign-risk context; no traceable earnings link to a specific tracked stock or sector
reviewed_stories.reason: Pakistan reaffirmed an unconditional defence commitment to Saudi Arabia under the Makkah Defence Alliance while also saying it is pursuing de-escalation. The statement raises broad geopolitical exposure but does not establish a company or sector cash-flow effect, so no tracked-stock rating is created.

reviewed_stories.title: Ningbo Green Light Energy set to be Pakistan's first listing via SPAC: report
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Market-structure story about a prospective listing; the target is not currently one of the tracked PSX stocks
reviewed_stories.reason: Ningbo Green Light Energy is awaiting court approval for a reverse takeover of LSE SPAC-I. This may become a future listed-company event, but it is not current company evidence for any tracked symbol, so no rating is created.

reviewed_stories.title: At least seven dead, dozens injured in Kohat blast
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Negative national-security event with no identified company or sector earnings mechanism in the article
reviewed_stories.reason: Rescue 1122 reported at least seven deaths and more than 30 injuries after an explosion near Old Police Lines in Kohat. The report gives no company, infrastructure, commodity, or sector transmission mechanism, so it is not converted into a tracked-stock rating.

GHNI.reason: Ghandhara Industries Limited reported FY26 profit of Rs6.93bn, up 51% year on year, with EPS of Rs162.57, sales up 62%, gross profit up 54%, lower finance costs and a Rs12 per share final dividend. This is direct company earnings evidence.
GHNI.relevance: Direct link: GHNI company earnings and dividend

OGDC.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration Companies

PPL.reason: Hormuz tanker attack confirms transit risk, but Brent fell to about $102.68 as Saudi workarounds and inventories eased scarcity fears. Positive upstream view remains, without a confidence upgrade.
PPL.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration Companies

MARI.reason: Hormuz tanker attack confirms transit risk, but Brent still fell near $102.68 as supply workarounds eased scarcity fears. MARI's gas-heavy mix keeps the positive crude linkage weaker.
MARI.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration Companies

PSO.reason: Fresh OMC industry evidence says Rs66.7bn of price-differential claims remain unsettled, liquidity is being drained while OMCs finance the supply chain, and an approved Rs1.22 per litre OMC margin increase remains unnotified. Dealer subsidy reimbursement clarity partly reduces implementation risk, while today's mixed petrol and diesel price changes leave the regulated OMC margin fixed at Rs7.87 per litre. The negative working-capital and margin evidence therefore outweighs the neutral daily price move for PSO as an OMC, without claiming a PSO-specific loss amount.
PSO.relevance: Sector link to PSO as an oil marketing company; not PSO-specific financial disclosure

Textile Composite.reason: Pakistan completed its fifth EU GSP+ review and is preparing for formal reapplication by December 2028. Continued preferential EU market access is constructive for export-oriented textile companies, but exposure and realised sales vary by company, so the linkage is sector-level and correlated rather than company-specific.

Technology/Telecom Devices.reason: Mobile-phone imports fell 8.85% while telecom-equipment imports rose 8.95%. The aggregate data do not identify AIRLINK sales, local assembly volumes or margins, so direction is ambiguous.
Technology/Telecom Devices.relevance: Sector link to Technology and Telecom Devices, including AIRLINK
